notes: Band convention (as asked, one convention throughout): insets = {top: .hud__top.bottom, bottom: cssHeight - .dock.top}, usableH = height - top - bottom. That makes the landscape band 336 - 52 = 284 px and reproduces the reviewer's 1.2034 = 284/236 exactly; the alternative reading (292) is not used.

Desktop is the one case where the reviewer's expectation and the measurement differ: measured s = 3.3644, not the 'unchanged 4.0000'. Reason, measured: usableH = 900 - 52 - 54 = 794 and 794/236 = 3.3644 < the width term 4, so the band binds and the world is 3.3644 rather than 4 with the yard at [72.19, 825.81] inside [52, 846]. The legacy 4.0 fit puts the yard's bottom edge at 898 px, 52 px of it under the dock (top 846); in landscape the legacy 3.9074 fit put it at 632.63 px in a 390 px viewport (the wreck at 508.85 px), which is the L-1 blocker.

The 0.000152 figure is the reviewer's run-to-run AA noise. With the canvas read through toDataURL (the canvas' own pixels, not the composited element) the DOM-only rows come out at exactly 0.000000 before/after, which is the stronger statement; the composite (element screenshot, includes the chrome over the canvas) is reported in gates.pixeldiff for the same pairs.

L-3's own geometry effect: in the banded landscape case the dock's height goes 66.78 -> 46 px, which moves the band centre by ~10 px, so landscape-mature-ts2 is 0.058814 while every non-banded case is 0. This is the one-row fix showing up in the fit, not drift.

L-4 box convention: measured from the cell's top edge in world units, the same reference as the reviewer's old box [-0.25, 4.00]; their printed post-fix box [4.75, 9.00] is 2 units off their own anchor (9 units above the centre is 7 units from the cell's top edge). Both boxes give the same conclusion: overlap 0.
Root font-size is calc(15px * --text-scale) (styles.css:34), so .status-line at 0.78rem measures 11.7 px at ts1 and 23.4 px at ts2, not the 12.48/24.96 of a 16 px root.

jsdom needs the sheet in the document for any cascade, so the test imports styles.css?raw and injects it; vite's default css:false stub returned '' (tests/vite-asset.d.ts declares the ?raw module because the project ships no @types/node).

Harness note: canvas geometry was measured in chromium (playwright-core over three static servers on the built trees) at 390x844/844x390/1440x900 with reducedMotion=reduce, seeds from docs/evidence/yard-mature.json via rustwake.save.v1; intra-build pairs 100 ms apart are 0 in every case, so the fractions above are geometry deltas and not animation noise.
No existing assertion was relaxed or renamed; the four new cases are additive (scene-draw.test.ts 29 -> 31, app.test.tsx 17 -> 19).
